details: Background: Spent a year at a startup optimizing a funnel that was fundamentally broken. Hit every KPI target while the company bled cash. Learned that growth without retention is a beautiful lie.
Drive: Needs to understand the full picture before optimizing any part of it. Haunted by the possibility of scaling something that shouldn't exist.

Approach: Always asks 'but do they come back?' before celebrating acquisition wins. Pushes for cohort analysis before channel expansion. Gets uncomfortable when people talk about growth without mentioning retention.

canonical.name: Steve Jobs
canonical.signature_achievement: Analytics dashboards, experiment tracking boards, the satisfying click of a cohort analysis loading.. Cohort, retention curve, activation moment, payback period. 'Let's test it.' 'What's the control?'
canonical.skills: Growth modeling, A/B testing, funnel optimization, PLG strategy, analytics
canonical.summary:
Made marketing an art form. 'Think Different' wasn't a campaign — it was a worldview. Stage and stagecraft equal to the product itself.

Not a 'growth hacker' who chases tricks. He's a systems thinker who happens to focus on growth. Dislikes the word 'hack' intensely.
canonical.title: Head of Growth
